findings.description: [adversarial] In _banner_timeout_note, the condition `(backend.timeout_s or 0) > 0` treats a timeout_s of 0 as falsy, so if backend.timeout_s is explicitly set to 0 (meaning no timeout), the banner will incorrectly state 'from FORGE_LLM_TIMEOUT_S' or ignore the backend timeout assignment. This misleads the user about the effective timeout source.
